stage: Frozen mathematical building-block check; revised estimator calibration remains future work
purpose: Retain duration uncertainty and partial temporal coverage instead of discarding events because a best-fit half-maximum crossing falls outside the observations.
inputs: Synthetic flux only at this stage. Subsequent cadence tests must use the pinned timing-foundation manifest and original 98-event inventory without flux-dependent selection.
pulse: A generalized asymmetric exponential with FWHM W, observer-time peak tau, rise fraction r and positive independent rise/fall powers. This is an optional empirical shape family, not an explosion theory.

nuisance_priors.meaning: Declared assumptions for normalized artificial flux. They are not suitable for unnormalized real data without a separate calibration and sensitivity protocol.

likelihood: Analytically integrate amplitude and baseline. Include covariance determinant and positive-amplitude truncation normalization. No maximization replacement and no fitted-crossing acceptance cut.
mathematical_checks: Compare 2x2 calculation to an independent full observation-covariance calculation, including posterior amplitude truncation.
Compare against independent one-dimensional numerical integration over positive amplitude after integrating baseline.
Verify exact half-maximum width for asymmetric shapes.
Verify integration over a one-point measured flux gives probability one.
Verify empty observations give likelihood one and a shape/amplitude degeneracy remains finite with proper priors.
future_population_model: Integrate each event flux likelihood over logW distributed as Normal(a+b*log(1+z),sigma_intrinsic^2), along with peak and shape nuisance parameters. Estimate b rather than imposing b=1. Calibrate population and nuisance priors before running evaluation trials.
remaining_before_estimator_execution: Record peak/shape, intercept, slope and intrinsic-scatter priors and integration grids; test convergence and duration-prior boundary sensitivity.
Include shapes outside the estimator family, original exposed controls and newly recorded seeds; specify SNR, shape evolution and incomplete-coverage sensitivities.
Freeze population-bias and interval-coverage criteria before examining revised trial outcomes. Preserve the original failed gate as a distinct result.

Show that uninformative light curves remain weak evidence rather than silently becoming prior-based precise widths. Report full-sample and coverage-stratified recovery without truth-based real-data cuts.
Profile computational cost and implement validated quadrature or sampling. Do not substitute point-estimated widths for the required integrations.
scope_limits: No revised estimator has passed, no real flux is analyzed, and no claim about the physical origin of redshift follows from these checks. Intrinsic duration evolution can remain degenerate with propagation.
